ॠ: ॠ ind. An interjection of (1) terror; (2) warding off; (3) reproach or censure; (4) compassion; (5) remembrance. --m. (ॠः) 1 N. of Bhairava. --2 A Dānava or demon. --f. 1 The mother of the gods; also of the demons. --2 Recollection. --3 Motion, going. --n. The breast.
ॠ {c9c} P. (ऋणाति, ईर्ण) To go, move.
